added_comments.text: # Drop fractional seconds of any length (the ledger keeps whole seconds).
# Same shapes with a trailing UTC offset such as ``+02:00`` or ``-0500``.

rationale: The offset failure is resolved by appending `%z` variants to the `_KNOWN_FORMATS` list, i.e. adding more entries to the brittle format-enumeration workaround rather than replacing it with real ISO-8601/offset-aware parsing; the `_clean` regex change generalizes the fraction-chopping hack but is not the cause of the reported ValueError. The Globex date-only end-of-day path (`_globex_end_of_day`, `_DATE_ONLY`) is untouched and the new `%z` formats are only added to time-bearing shapes, so the protected behavior is preserved.
